status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Tauri 2 + React + FastAPI sidecar skeleton with session-token auth
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app starts, launches the Python backend on a random localhost port, and the frontend can call an authenticated /health endpoint.
verification: uv run pytest passes in /backend.
npm run build succeeds in the frontend.
cargo check succeeds in /src-tauri.
Backend rejects requests without the session token (covered by tests).
evidence: 2026-10-28: ./init.sh full run passed end to end: ruff clean, uv run pytest 8 passed (session 002, PROGRESS.md), tsc && vite build ok, cargo check ok.
2026-10-28: live sidecar smoke test: curl /health -> 401 without token, 200 with Bearer token on 127.0.0.1.
2026-10-28: backend/tests/test_auth.py: 8 tests covering missing/wrong token, wrong scheme, unknown routes, unset token, env-provided token.
features.notes: Phase 1 step 1. Rust core stays minimal: window, sidecar spawn, token, two commands. Comes with README (setup/dev/build instructions) and .env.example.

features.title: SQLite + SQLModel + Alembic base models
features.user_visible_behavior: The app creates and migrates its local database with the core tables on first run.
verification: uv run alembic upgrade head applies migrations from empty to current.
A downgrade to base and re-upgrade also succeeds.
pytest covers model round-trips (create, read, update, delete).
features.notes: Phase 1 step 2. Tables per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Data Storage.

features.title: OpenRouter client: keychain key, live model catalog, capability-aware structured output, usage tracking
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can save an OpenRouter API key in Settings, browse the live model catalog, and run a test call; structured tasks work on models without native structured outputs via fallback.
verification: Contract tests with a mocked OpenRouter endpoint pass for the structured-output fallback path (supported_parameters honored, JSON-mode retry with validation error feedback).
API key is stored in the OS keychain and never appears in logs or DB (test asserts masked display).
Token usage and cost per request are recorded in the EventLog.

features.title: Profile creation: manual entry and CV import with LLM extraction
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can fill in their profile manually or import a CV (PDF/DOCX) and correct the LLM-extracted structured profile.
verification: Manual create/edit of identity, skills, experiences, education, languages works end to end.
CV import with a mocked LLM produces a structured profile the user can edit.
Unit tests pass for the parsing pipeline with fixture PDFs.

features.title: France Travail job source, saved criteria, offer list
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can save search criteria, run a search against France Travail, and see normalized deduplicated offers.
verification: Contract tests for the France Travail source pass with recorded fixtures.
Duplicate offers across runs are deduplicated (hash check in tests).
Saved criteria persist and rerun correctly.
features.notes: Phase 1 step 5. Adzuna and Jooble come in Phase 2 behind the same JobSource interface.

features.title: Matching: embedding similarity + LLM re-ranking
features.user_visible_behavior: Offers are scored 0-100 against the profile, with rationale, matched and missing skills, and can be sorted and filtered by score.
verification: Unit tests pass for stage 1 (embedding similarity) and stage 2 (LLM scoring with mocked provider).
MatchResult rows store the model used.
Offers list is sorted by score.
features.notes: Phase 1 step 6. Embedding provider independent from chat model.

features.title: Letter generation with anti-hallucination grounding check
features.user_visible_behavior: The user gets an adapted letter, email subject and body per selected offer, with unsupported claims flagged.
verification: Structured output (letter, subject, body, claims) validates against its Pydantic schema in tests.
Grounding check flags a fabricated skill in a fixture letter (test with mocked verifier).
French and English offers produce letters in the offer's language.

features.title: Review screen: diff, inline editing, streamed regeneration, approve/reject
features.user_visible_behavior: The user reviews each offer/letter side by side, edits, regenerates with instructions or another model, and chooses approve/send, save-as-draft, or reject.
verification: Diff against the base letter renders correctly.
Regeneration streams into the editor.
Unsupported claims are highlighted.
No send path is reachable without the confirmation dialog (hard rule).
features.notes: Phase 1 step 8. HARD RULE: nothing sent without explicit per-application confirmation.

features.title: Gmail draft creation via OAuth2 (PKCE), direct send behind a setting
features.user_visible_behavior: The user connects Gmail and approved applications are created as drafts in their mailbox; direct send exists but is opt-in.
verification: OAuth2 (PKCE) flow works against mocked Gmail endpoints in tests.
Draft creation is the default; direct send requires the explicit setting and a confirmation click.
Tokens are stored in the OS keychain only.
features.notes: Phase 1 step 9. Outlook/Graph and SMTP come in Phase 2.

features.title: Application tracking view
features.user_visible_behavior: The user sees all applications by status with a timeline per application.
verification: List and Kanban views render from real Application data.
Status transitions update timestamps and the timeline.
Follow-up dates are shown.
features.notes: Phase 1 step 10. Reminders and reply detection come in Phase 2.

features.title: Additional job sources: Adzuna and Jooble
features.user_visible_behavior: Searches run across Adzuna and Jooble in addition to France Travail, with cross-source deduplication.
verification: Contract tests with recorded fixtures pass for both sources.
The same offer found on two sources appears once.

features.title: Outlook (Microsoft Graph) and SMTP/IMAP fallback
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can connect Outlook or a generic SMTP/IMAP mailbox.
verification: Graph OAuth2 (PKCE) flow works with mocked endpoints.
SMTP fallback creates drafts or sends per settings, with rate limiting.

features.title: Scheduled searches, follow-up reminders, desktop notifications
features.user_visible_behavior: Periodic offer searches run automatically and the user gets notified of follow-ups.
verification: APScheduler jobs are idempotent across restarts.
A due follow-up produces a desktop notification.
features.notes: Phase 2. The scheduler may never trigger a send (ADR 0003).

features.title: Direct Anthropic/OpenAI and local Ollama providers; budget cap
features.user_visible_behavior: The user can choose providers other than OpenRouter, including a fully local mode, and set a monthly budget cap.
verification: LLMProvider interface contract tests pass for all implementations with mocked endpoints.
Budget cap blocks further generations with a clear message in tests.

features.title: UI in French and English (i18next)
features.user_visible_behavior: The whole UI can be switched between French and English.
verification: Language switch updates all visible strings.
No hardcoded user-facing strings remain in components.

features.title: Sidecar packaging (PyInstaller externalBin) and CI for Windows/macOS/Linux
features.user_visible_behavior: Installable builds are produced for the three OSes from CI.
verification: PyInstaller produces one sidecar binary per OS/architecture, declared in tauri.conf.json.
GitHub Actions matrix build produces installers for all three OSes.

features.title: Signed installers, auto-update, user documentation
features.user_visible_behavior: Users get signed installers with an auto-update path and complete documentation.
verification: Signed installers for all three OSes install and run.
Update from an older version works.
README and user docs cover setup, build and packaging.
